svg.title: MILESTONES · UP TO RELEASE 46
svg.desc: Foundation: Card, invitation gate, profile, CV. First release. Content: Building blocks as the source. Agents propose via MCP. Guests & name: Scroll story, two languages, parallel coding agents. Renamed cvitea, optional PIN. Web app: Applications hub, cockpit, building blocks. GitHub sync, LinkedIn import. v1.0: Stage video, one download, web app in two languages. Hero media: Hero media and a new editor, a new head on tablets and phones.
